correctness.rationale: Independent full enumeration of 201 proper partitions, [201,1865,4245,2700] chains, and [41,326,720,454] regular C6 flag orbits. Independent integer unit-pivot contraction gives 40+286+432=758 cancellations and residual ranks [1,0,2,22]; residual d3 entries all multiples of 3, with rank two and a 2x2 minor of absolute value nine, so Smith diagonal (3,3). The two-block parity partition is fixed by a generator of C6; since proper Pi6 has homotopy wedge of 120 S3, Armstrong kills the quotient pi1. A simply connected 3D CW complex has two-skeleton a 2-sphere wedge, and 3-cell attaching maps live in the free pi2 lattice; Smith changes of bases yield two degree-3 Moore spaces and 20 spheres. This is a finite complete calculation, not an infinite formula.
